name: g1_walk
title: Walk (forward locomotion, heading-aware, velocity-tracked)
summary: The foundational G1 walk: an LSTM+REF_OBS whole-body policy that shadows the recorded official-motion ghost through bounded leg corridors (leg = ghost(phase) + a*GHOST_RESIDUAL) with a tent velocity reward, heading-in-obs, and human arm swing. It is the BATON PRIMARY policy every sequence rides on. The straight flagship profile is measured at 0.120 m/s on its weight-bearing balance harness.

ghost.notes: AUTHENTIC official motion.pt re-recording (legs + true 2.54deg sway); arms are owner-endorsed DESIGN (no official arm reference exists).

baton.notes: The cyclic 120-dim obs family; element-wise blendable with the other cyclic specialists (stand, carry). walk-exits are double-support-gated (BATON_DS_GATE).

train.notes: Recipe = tent velocity + heading-in-obs + ghost leg-imitation corridor + asymmetric privileged critic + push/motor/latency/IC DR. Exact frozen bundle: see docs/developer/g1-walk-recipe.md + memory project_g1_walk_recipe_solved / project_lstm_foresight_breakthrough. VERIFY before re-training.

verification.result: 2026-07-17 exact flagship headless run on machine 9722d23d12a3 (RTX 3060 Laptop, build 3ef8ce85, Newton/mujoco_warp): 0.120 m/s over 15.04 s, 0% backward samples, 1.1% lateral drift, max |yaw| 0.148 rad, upright z 0.739..0.778. Runs on the lambda=0.9 weight-bearing balance harness; not free-standing.
